 Principal Platform Architect Who We Look For
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Principal Platform Architect** 
 to define, build, and evolve the cloud platform and internal developer platform that underpin UST FinX's engineering organization.
   

  

 This is a senior, hands\-on technical leadership role — not a people\-management position.
   

  

 Your influence will come from designing strong platform foundations, making sound architectural decisions, building production\-grade infrastructure and platform capabilities, mentoring engineers, and raising engineering standards across multiple teams.
   

  

 You will own the technical direction of our platform engineering capabilities across
 **AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, automated delivery, observability, security, reliability, and developer experience** 
 .
   

  

 The goal is not to build infrastructure independently for every project. You will create reusable platform capabilities that can support multiple products, clients, environments, and engineering teams consistently.
   

  

 You understand that a platform is itself an engineering product used by other engineers. It must be reliable, secure, observable, automated, documented, maintainable, and easy to consume.
   

  

 You remain close to implementation: reviewing architecture, building infrastructure and platform components, improving deployment automation, writing code, investigating production issues, and helping teams solve difficult operational problems.
   

  

 You understand that good platform engineering is not simply about provisioning infrastructure. It requires balancing developer autonomy with standardisation, security with usability, abstraction with transparency, and delivery speed with operational control.
   

  

 In an AI\-assisted engineering environment, you apply strong technical judgment to validate, refine, and sometimes reject generated output. Infrastructure and platform code must meet the same standards for correctness, resilience, security, maintainability, and operational safety as manually produced engineering work.
   

  

 We value a collaborative, merit\-driven engineering culture. Senior architects are expected to constructively challenge weak designs, simplify unnecessary complexity, make pragmatic technical decisions, and help the organisation converge on strong reusable engineering patterns.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Define and evolve the technical architecture of the UST FinX cloud platform and internal developer platform.

Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  
Prior cross\-product or cross\-org architecture role at a similarly sized enterprise software company.
  
Breadth across data warehousing, lakehouses, data platforms, graphs, and vector technologies, valued over deep specialization in a single area.

Experience with graph databases and building knowledge graphs.

Experience designing streaming data architectures (e.g., Kafka, Flink, Delta Live Tables, or equivalent) alongside batch/medallion patterns.

The Solution Architect – FinTech is responsible for defining, designing, and delivering end\-to\-end technical and business solutions across digital payments, mobile money, lending, KYC, digital identity, merchant solutions, and financial services platforms. This role requires strong financial domain knowledge, deep technical expertise, and the ability to work consultatively with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. The architect will lead solution scoping, requirement analysis, technical design, and deployment oversight while ensuring compliance, security, performance, and regulatory alignment across markets.

  

Key Responsibilities


FinTech Solution Design \& Architecture  

Design scalable, secure, and regulatory\-compliant solutions for digital payments, wallets, merchant transactions, lending, credit scoring, and financial ecosystem integrations.  

Analyze customer financial operations, transaction flows, risk controls, and compliance requirements to define optimized solutions.  

Translate business requirements into detailed technical designs spanning cloud, APIs, microservices, protocols, and core financial systems.  

Ensure solutions adhere to financial industry standards (PCI\-DSS, ISO 8583, ISO 20022, AML/CFT, data privacy, etc.).  

Customer Engagement \& Consultative Advisory  

Engage with banks, fintech operators, mobile money providers, and partners to understand business goals and technical landscapes.

Provide architectural governance and ensure alignment with solution blueprint throughout delivery.  

Conduct infrastructure capacity planning, performance evaluation, and transaction throughput modeling.  

Work closely with product, engineering, risk, and operations teams to ensure successful deployment.  

Cross\-Functional Collaboration  

Collaborate with product roadmap teams, R\&D, and engineering to translate market needs into platform features.  

Provide continuous feedback to improve solutions, architecture patterns, and product capabilities.

  

Technical Skills


Architecture design (cloud/on\-prem), microservices, containerization, high\-availability and DR setups.  

Performance tuning, capacity estimation, and infra planning for high\-volume financial transactions.


Strong understanding of digital payments, wallets, mobile money, merchant acquiring, lending platforms, KYC/AML, fraud systems, and transaction processing.  

Experience with financial protocols and integrations — ISO 8583, ISO 20022, REST/JSON APIs, SOAP, SFTP, OAuth2, JWT, Webhooks.  

Knowledge of financial compliance, risk controls, settlement processes, reconciliation, and transaction dispute flows.  

Experience with AI/ML and automation in financial use cases (fraud detection, credit prediction, operational optimization).  

Business \& Leadership Skills  

Strong consultative and customer\-facing capabilities.  

Financial acumen to understand revenue models, pricing, ROI, and commercial impact.  

Ability to mentor, guide teams, and collaborate across multi\-functional units.  

Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and negotiation skills.
